topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that detect speech versus non-speech (or voiced/unvoiced, mouth open/closed as a VAD proxy, speech onset/endpoint) from a non-acoustic signal: lip/face video, ultrasound tongue imaging, ultrasonic Doppler, radar, EMG, EMA, EEG/MEG/ECoG. Boundary: audio-visual systems count when a visual-only or non-acoustic branch is evaluated; papers that only apply an acoustic VAD to their audio match the pattern and inflate the upper bound.
topics.metric: frame-level accuracy / AUC / F1 for speech vs non-speech; higher is better

topics.inclusion_rule: Same population as M06/non-acoustic-speech-activity-detection; classify where the speech/non-speech training labels come from: an acoustic VAD or energy on the synchronized audio, forced alignment of the audio, or manual annotation. Boundary: papers that only use audio VAD for preprocessing match the pattern (upper bound).

Same population as M06/non-acoustic-speech-activity-detection; classify the evaluation protocol of the detector: held-out speakers (speaker-independent, leave-one-subject-out), held-out sessions, or a single speaker. Boundary: a pattern hit in a paper that uses VAD only as preprocessing counts toward the upper bound.

Include studies that synthesize speech or acoustic features from ultrasound tongue images (with or without lip video) and evaluate the output; classify the output measures used (MCD or other spectral distance, MUSHRA or MOS ratings, listener transcription or identification, ASR on the synthesized speech). Boundary: exclude recognition-only studies, contour tracking and reviews (they inflate the pattern match, an upper bound); count versions once by key.
